page_title: VER 1-1 JUV | Verona v Juventus 20/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' The ratio of the ball possession is 28:72.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Suat Serdar makes way for Yellu Santiago (Verona).
89' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Gift Orban will be replaced by Junior Ajayi (Verona).
87' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
86' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
84' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
83' A substitution has been made. Joao Mario goes off and Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) comes on.
81' Gift Orban (Verona) commits a foul and Antonio Rapuano immediately signals a free kick.

81' Lois Openda (Juventus) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
80' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
80' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
80' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
79' Michele Di Gregorio stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Martin Frese (Verona) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom left corner.
79' The corner from Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is intercepted by the defence.
77' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Rafik Belghali is replaced by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cheikh Niasse (Verona) will replace Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro.
76' Antoine Bernede (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
75' Lois Openda (Juventus) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
73' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but his effort lacks accuracy and goes well out of play.
72' Victor Nelsson (Verona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul. Juventus are awarded the free kick.
70' Igor Tudor has decided to make a change. Jonathan David (Juventus) replaces Francisco Conceicao.
70' The goal by Verona won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
69' The Verona players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
67' Suat Serdar (Verona) shows that he can easily score goals using his head after netting another fantastic header!
67' The ball is out of play. Verona will have a chance to score from a corner.
65' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
65' Lois Openda (Juventus) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Francisco Conceicao.
64' That's a well-taken pass by Gift Orban (Verona). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
63' Substitution. Giovane is replaced by Amin Sarr (Verona).
62' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) swings in a cross from the corner, but Michele Di Gregorio reads it well and gathers the ball.

61' Rafik Belghali (Verona) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
61' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
60' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
58' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post.
57' Igor Tudor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lois Openda (Juventus) replacing Dusan Vlahovic.
57' It's time for a substitution. Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) comes on in place of Khephren Thuram.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Verona comes to nothing.
51' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).

51' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Lorenzo Montipo pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
48' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
46' Igor Tudor makes a switch. Teun Koopmeiners is coming on in place of Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Antonio Rapuano shows a yellow card to Gift Orban (Verona) for his blatant foul.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Gift Orban (Verona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Michele Di Gregorio into right side of the goal.
44' Gift Orban (Verona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
42' Handball! A player from Juventus handled the ball. PENALTY to Verona! Great chance to score.
39' Igor Tudor is stunned as referee Antonio Rapuano shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
39' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
36' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. Antoine Bernede (Verona) commits a foul after dangerous play.
34' Ball possession – 26:74.
29' Suat Serdar (Verona) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
28' Good clearance! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
27' Verona have a corner.
26' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
24' A long ball forward to Gift Orban (Verona) is intercepted.
22' Antoine Bernede (Verona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

19' 0 - 1 Goal! Great play by Khephren Thuram releases Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 0:1.
15' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Rapuano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
14' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
9' Federico Gatti (Juventus) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
8' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
7' Yellow card. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
6' Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Antoine Bernede (Verona).
2' Joao Mario (Juventus) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
